description: Minister of Justice and National Integration -  reciprocal  Recognition Registration and Enforcement of Foreign Judgements Act, No. 49 of 2024.
categorisation: This gazette content involves the implementation and operationalization of the "Reciprocal Recognition, Registration and Enforcement of Foreign Judgements Act, No. 49 of 2024." It contains orders that declare the application of the Act to specific foreign countries and appoint the date when the Act comes into operation. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it deals with statutory instruments and the implementation of legislation, specifically focusing on legal frameworks for recognizing foreign judgments.
